notes: soundLAB 1.3.0: the Synth tab. Your synth gets its own tab with three pills: Deck (a play face with faders instead of knobs, a knob-row picker like the MODX, Assign knobs named after what they control, Scenes, chips and an Explain mode that teaches what each control does), Live (Live sets in pages of 16, foot switch and octave-button stepping, Go live with Lock and Panic, whole-setup profiles you can export and import) and Hub (the MIDI Hub, now with key splits and port-aware rules). Presets save a full snapshot: sound, fader values, colour, the app key and scale, a split. One Open on the Play tab opens a MIDI file, a MusicXML score or a text tab and sends it to the synth, the Woodshed or tab view. The Practice tab is now Train, the clef is a header icon like its neighbours, and long page notes moved into tours and tips.
